scope: opt-in INSTALL_POSE_DEPS=1 build; default Bumi image unchanged
method: PyPI JSON API wheel download size, pinned versions, cp310 aarch64 (Bumi interpreter/arch)
limitation: prepared on x86_64 host without a Docker daemon; no end-to-end ARM64 image build performed here, so this is wheel-level evidence with a reproduction procedure for the whole-image delta, not a measured docker inspect delta

smaller_alternative.note: the x86_64 torch 2.8.0 wheel is 846.9 MiB (bundles CUDA/cuDNN); the aarch64 wheel is 97.3 MiB, already the smallest official CPU build for Bumi
smaller_alternative.separate_processor_image_rejected: card runs in-bundle on local ROS topics; a second image would add cross-container transport and a release unit for one optional card

reproduction: build default and INSTALL_POSE_DEPS=1 images at the same commit; compare docker image inspect .Size and the sum of Docker Engine image-history layer Size entries
